Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Vera Zielinski | DOB: 12/03/1992 | MRN: SYN-4195754
Date of service: 03/25/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Draycott, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
32-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2024, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 40 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.5 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
